component: Account Hub shadow-root and browser-fixture Fluent resource registration

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up removes accountSetup.ftl from three shadow-root DOMLocalization lists and 12 browser-fixture document links. It keeps branding/accountHub resources and actual root connections; string IDs and bodies do not change here. The old Fluent file remains in the repository, so the change is scoped registration cleanup rather than global file removal. Current close/minimize/welcome IDs are present in accountHub.ftl. The earlier string migration is a separate phase. No exhaustive dynamic-ID resolution, engine formatting or localization/browser execution was verified.
title: The Account Hub follow-up removes old resource registrations without deleting accountSetup.ftl
